text:
selene: quick follow-up from RFC review: pick a default for Private egress. Options: shared regional relay (single pool per region) or per-tenant siloed pools. need recommendation for docs/sales.

amos: shared relay + tenant tagging = simpler ops, fewer IPs. downside: must enforce isolation at scheduler and preserve attribution.

minh: siloed is easiest for compliance and allows dedicated IP blocks for customers who need them. but costs more and wastes IPs.

jordyn: security: shared requires provenance headers or mTLS identity. cert surface increases for siloed too. we should evaluate short-lived certs for shared.

ops_bot: rfc/2026 CI: hybrid-proposal tests passed (ci#402).

selene: proposal: default to shared regional relay, offer paid dedicated pools (opt-in) for enterprise. hybrid gives sales a clear line.

amos: agree. action: I will run IP consumption sim and scheduler quota spike.

minh: I'll contact two compliance customers to validate opt-in requirements and lead times.

jordyn: I'll draft provenance header schema and short-lived cert flow, measure latency impact.

selene: thanks. I'll update RFC and the Private onboarding doc. reconvene after spikes land. :white_check_mark:
